participation.context: Broke on one word, said the line again, and did not ask about the glass.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the glass on the seat, and sent him home to count silver.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Hung the plot, and refused to restore the cut.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Would rather hear the word than a story about the word.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Stood by the door, and was told the gown is the one he has.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

relations.note: the glass is not for asking
relations.quote: Nobody is to ask me why.
Still is the work, when the line is not mine.

story.body: You failed the word once and got through it once. You left Richard's glass where he had set it. You told Nick the gown would not be lengthened today. You went home to pay the quarter.

title: Broke once on sceptred and held the line the second time
